title: Result.try adapts a throwing body into a Result whose failure channel keeps Panic
notes: poc/src/language/README.md: 'The public Result.try/Result.tryPromise adapters are accepted in authored .sm with their documented Panic-retaining types. The inline callback body is an authored boundary.' specification/failures.mdx requires a caller to 'propagate panic, explicitly catch it, or use a trusted adapter that catches and translates it'; Result.try is that adapter, and the declared Result<number, Panic> is the translated channel. `parseIntegerUnchecked` deliberately carries no @throws claim.
